signal: LeagueApps took growth investment led by Accel-KKR with Arctos, acquired MOD11 and RecTimes, and partnered with Ankored, expanding its youth sports platform

email.body1:
Nick, saw LeagueApps took the Accel-KKR backed investment and is rolling up the space with MOD11, RecTimes, and the Ankored partnership.

Growth and acquisitions like that open far more sports organizations worth reaching than reps can personally cover, and good accounts stall while the team works the easy fit. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for LeagueApps off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nick, quick follow-up for LeagueApps.

With new capital and a wider product set from the acquisitions, board expectations on pipeline climb faster than headcount, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap surfaces late, then it is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings LeagueApps needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nick, last bit of proof for LeagueApps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how LeagueApps' reply rate likely compares to similar vertical-SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nick, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Post-investment integration is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a vertical-SaaS motion? I will tailor it to LeagueApps either way.
